primary_independent_audit.scope: All retained material methods/CFAs and published native cells, independently recomputed. Real low-ISO and native-binned references remain approximate; no real-reference PSNR or model recommendation.

faint_supplement_scope: Prospectively frozen descriptive supplement to the already-declared102-call V136 full-original1000 endpoint review. Sixteen retained faintADC observations/four contexts, all4CFAs, no extra data/model/noise/RAW/optimizer execution, no global ranking claim. Original-source masks and shared40x display follow the prior faint precision definition; independent mirroredFFT/channelwise-display/long-double audit follows.

actual_visual_review.method: Actual original-resolution view_image inspection; all38 images were delivered and inspected without resizing.
findings: Actual viewing finds coherent larger bark structure but attenuated fine hairs, grass and wood grain. Differences between V129 and V136 are subtle.
Fine hairs remain smeared, and the deepest crops lose substantial texture and retain color blotches. There is no clear large visible recovery over either control.
Normal8-bit faint panels look almost identical. The enhanced boards reveal residual colored texture and softened fine detail, with no clear broad recovery by V136.
Foliage remains soft/painterly; the larger fence and building geometry stay coherent and the sky quiet. No clear large new detail recovery is visible.

Nominal conditioning still largely erases the lattice. The nearby profile retains weak irregular diagonal texture in all three models, without a clear new correct-lattice recovery. The left blue point persists.

report_text.TITLE: tiny score gains over V129; fine mesh still missing
report_text.CONCLUSION: Matched1k V136 gives tiny panel-mean gains over V129, without a clear large recovery of weak photographic detail.
report_text.MAIN_FINDING: Versus V120, ordinary and gain1/8 means rise slightly, while both gain1/32 means and faint ADC fall. These finite gains are documented without treating the pilot as a broad quality ranking.
report_text.ORDINARY_FINDING: Against V129, the selected fur/wood gains rise but their errors also rise; grass loses a little projected response while its error falls. The branch does not uniformly recover weak detail.
report_text.MATERIAL_VIEWING: Actual viewing finds coherent larger bark structure but attenuated fine hairs, grass and wood grain. Differences between V129 and V136 are subtle.
report_text.SHADOW_VIEWING: Fine hairs remain smeared, and the deepest crops lose substantial texture and retain color blotches. There is no clear large visible recovery over either control.
report_text.FAINT_FINDING: Relative to V129, selected fur/wood gains increase alongside higher relative errors; grass improves slightly in both gain and error. The arithmetic mean of per-observation PSNR rises, but pooled MSE barely changes and centered spatial MSE increases. The ROI-mean error component decreases. Thus the mean PSNR gain does not establish improved spatial detail.
report_text.FAINT_VIEWING: Normal8-bit faint panels look almost identical. The enhanced boards reveal residual colored texture and softened fine detail, with no clear broad recovery by V136.
report_text.GFX_VIEWING: Foliage remains soft/painterly; the larger fence and building geometry stay coherent and the sky quiet. No clear large new detail recovery is visible.
report_text.MESH_VIEWING: Nominal conditioning still largely erases the lattice. The nearby profile retains weak irregular diagonal texture in all three models, without a clear new correct-lattice recovery. The left blue point persists.
report_text.FINAL_DECISION: No20k global run is queued from this result. Although all18 tensors have nonzero gradients, the retained memory-path maxima are very small: latents1.07e−11 and memory gain2.46e−14, versus1.89e−3 at the output projection. This is an optimization concern, not a measured causal explanation or evidence that global attention cannot help.

actual_visual_review.recommendation: V120 Small remains general recommendation. V136 has tiny matched1k gains over V129 on this finite support, mixed local detail and no clear new fine-mesh recovery. Retain measured gains and images; no general promotion or20k global run.
actual_visual_review.unviewed_primary_triplets: Audited pixel subsets of actually viewed comparison boards; not separately claimed as viewed.

recommendation: V120 Small remains general recommendation. V136 has tiny matched1k gains over V129 on this finite support, mixed local detail and no clear new fine-mesh recovery. Retain measured gains and images; no general promotion or20k global run.
limits: Full original1000 pilot endpoint, not20k or full427 photo/camera/color/fullframe. Four material contexts/one draw perCFA; native binned refs approximate. New global branch compared with saved V129 control on exact matched training inputs; V120 comparison also includes continued training. No primary-history point or selector change.
